stemMd: A closed rectangular box measures 2 by 3 by 7 units. What is its total surface area?
explanationMd: There are pairs of faces with areas 6,14 and 21. Total surface area is 2(6+14+21)=82 square units.

distractorRationale.b: This counts only one face of each opposite pair.
distractorRationale.c: This is the volume, not surface area.
distractorRationale.d: This doubles volume rather than summing face areas.
